learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will expand their knowledge of Verbs by adding '-ing' to show actions that are happening RIGHT NOW.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 We know what action words are! But how do we say we are doing an action right at this exact moment? We use a special magic spell called 'I-N-G'! ✨ Let's see how it works.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: When we add the letters 'i-n-g' to the end of an Action Word (Verb), it shows that the action is happening RIGHT NOW. We usually use Is, Am, or Are with these words.
Remember our helping verbs? We use 'Am' for I, and 'Is' for singular words, followed by the '-ing' action word.
For plural words (We, You, They, or many people), we use 'Are' followed by the '-ing' action word.

lesson_modules.module_title: 🔄 Double Letter Secret (दोहरे अक्षर का जादू)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: Sometimes, when a word is very short, the last letter gets doubled before adding '-ing'!

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Choose the correct sentence for right now:

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Add '-ing' to this word: Talk -> ______
subjective_practice.hint: Just stick the three magic letters at the end!

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blank: The dog is _____ (bark).
subjective_practice.hint: Add the magic '-ing' spell to the word in the bracket.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Change to an '-ing' word: Run -> ______
subjective_practice.hint: Remember the double letter secret! Double the 'n'.

activity_or_assignment.title: 🎨 The 'Right Now' Reporter
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Pretend you are a news reporter on TV 🎤. Look around your house and report 3 things happening right now using '-ing'. (E.g., 'Mom is cooking! The fan is spinning!')

chapter_summary: ⭐ Adding '-ing' to a verb shows the action is happening right now.
⭐ We use Is, Am, or Are before the '-ing' word.
⭐ Some short words double their last letter (Run -> Running).
